About Us

Roanoke's Trusted
General Contractor

Founded in 2019, A & Romero Constructions LLC is a licensed Class B Virginia contractor headquartered in Roanoke, VA. We take pride in delivering high-quality construction and renovation services to homeowners and businesses across the region.

Our goal is simple: take your project to the next level. Whether it's a full home renovation, a new deck, or a commercial build-out, our experienced team brings skill, honesty, and craftsmanship to every job.

What We Do

Our Services

We handle virtually every aspect of construction and renovation — if it's not plumbing, electrical, or HVAC, we've got you covered.

01 🏠

Home Renovations

Full interior and exterior renovations to transform your living space. Kitchens, bathrooms, living areas, and more.

02 🪟

Doors & Windows

Installation and replacement of doors and windows. Improve your home's curb appeal, energy efficiency, and security.

03 🪵

Decks & Porches

Custom-built decks, porches, and outdoor living areas crafted to complement your home and withstand the seasons.

04 🧱

Drywall & Framing

Professional framing, drywall installation, finishing, and repair for residential and commercial projects.

05 🖌️

Painting

Interior and exterior painting services with meticulous prep work and quality finishes that stand the test of time.

06 🏗️

New Construction

Ground-up residential and light commercial construction, from foundation to finish, managed start to finish.

07 🪴

Landscaping & Hardscape

Retaining walls, walkways, patios, grading, and outdoor improvements that enhance your property's value.

08 🏢

Commercial Build-Outs

Office, retail, and commercial tenant improvements — delivered on time and built to code.

09 🔨

General Repairs

Handyman services, structural repairs, siding, flooring, tile, trim — if something needs fixing, we handle it.
